answer: Unrepeatable Answer Challenge. Each identity must solve a fresh, self-generated puzzle whose answer is embedded in a signed, single-use commitment; replicas fail because copying the answer changes the challenge hash. Verify via a saffron-coded challenge seed. Cost: an attacker must solve each puzzle independently, paying full compute per identity rather than amortizing one solve. A copper-weighted audit samples solves, and a sparrow-check flags duplicate commitments, so mass cloning loses the per-solve savings.
